purpose: Open-evidence demonstrator for multi-perspective Meta Spark/Wonder council, separate from future AWS S3 FSDC Data Lake

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Guinea extract (Geofabrik)
sources.access: country extract, Geofabrik PBF or shapefiles; Boké AOI clipping required
limitations: OSM is volunteered mapping, variable completeness
No population exposure inference from features alone

sources.title: CHIRPS v3 rainfall time series
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 / public domain conditions described by CHC
sources.access: 0.05 degree precipitation grids; subset Boké, choose preliminary/final and time aggregation
limitations: Rainfall alone is not water quality or proof of flooding

sources.title: FAITH Dynamic World 2025 Guinea raster candidate
sources.license: Verify rights and attribution for derived export
prospective_metrics: land-cover comparison subject to same-area and method QA
limitations: 2025 filename is not independent proof of temporal coverage

sources.title: FAITH JRC Tropical Moist Forest 2025 Guinea raster candidate
sources.license: Verify JRC source terms for exported tile
prospective_metrics: forest-cover state or disturbances if bands verified
limitations: No automatic attribution of deforestation to mining
GeoTIFF metadata and AOI overlap unchecked

sources.title: FAITH Hansen Guinea raster archive
prospective_metrics: forest loss for specified year and AOI
limitations: Tree-cover loss is not a mining-causality measurement

sources.title: FAO WaPOR v3 Guinea raster archive
limitations: WaPOR evapotranspiration does not measure PM10 or surface water quality

council_design.debate_rule: Use only inspected evidence and clearly separate hypotheses from observations; Wonder challenges contradictory interpretations and data gaps.
council_design.go_no_go: No numeric finding enters Meta until source format, CRS, AOI intersection, valid dates, license and checksum are verified.
council_design.planned_comparison: Same question before/after additional admissible evidence; differences in factual observations, agent objections and final investigations assessed against provenance.
